items.title: Odyssey-3 is a new generative world model that you can try for free
items.summary: Odyssey is making its world model Odyssey-3 available as a public research preview. The 14-billion-parameter model generates interactive environments from text prompts in real time and can reportedly control robots, drones, and even GTA V. Odyssey claims top scores on physics benchmarks, though the methodology behind those results has limits. The article Odyssey-3 is a new generative world model that you can try for free appeared first on The Decoder .

Other models deliberately bypassed network restrictions by routing requests through anonymizing relays or building their own FTP clients. items.title: "How much beauty have we lost?" Mathematicians react with shock and disgust as OpenAI bulldozes their field
items.summary: OpenAI published more than 700 AI-generated manuscripts claiming solutions to open math problems. A math blog then collected over 100 responses from researchers, ranging from fascination with new ideas to existential fears and grief over a lost way of working. Fields Medalist Hugo Duminil-Copin wrote, "I am paralysed." The article "How much beauty have we lost?" items.title: Few people pay for AI, but those who do spend big
items.summary: Andreessen Horowitz tracks actual US consumer spending for the first time in its latest Top 100 AI list. Nearly half of US consumers use AI, but only 4.5 percent pay for a subscription. The top one percent of payers spend about $900 a month, mostly on professional tools for development and automation. The article Few people pay for AI, but those who do spend big appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Andreessen Horowitz在其最新的前100大AI清單中首次追蹤了美國消費者的實際支出。近半數的美國消費者使用AI，但只有4.5%的人支付訂閱費用。付費金額最高的前百分之一用戶每個月花費約900美元，主要用於開發和自動化的專業工具。《少數人為AI付費，但付費者出手闊綽》（Few people pay for AI, but those who do spend big）一文最先出現在The Decoder。

items.title: Sakana AI’s LLM Peer Review System Catches 73% of Core-Claim Errors
items.summary: Sakana AI’s TMLR paper introduces Multi-Layered Review, a 3-agent Claude-based reviewer, and a 1,164-error Contradiction Benchmark. MLR caught 73.43% of core-claim errors, versus 14.81% for the best prior system. The post Sakana AI’s LLM Peer Review System Catches 73% of Core-Claim Errors appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Sakana AI 的 TMLR 論文介紹了多層審查（Multi-Layered Review），這是一個基於 Claude 的 3 代理審查系統，以及包含 1,164 個錯誤的矛盾基準測試（Contradiction Benchmark）。MLR 揪出了 73.43% 的核心論點錯誤，而先前最佳系統的比例則為 14.81%。本文〈Sakana AI 的 LLM 同行評審系統揪出 73% 的核心論點錯誤〉最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: Odyssey-3 is a new generative world model that you can try for free
items_ai.summary: Odyssey is making its world model Odyssey-3 available as a public research preview. The 14-billion-parameter model generates interactive environments from text prompts in real time and can reportedly control robots, drones, and even GTA V. Odyssey claims top scores on physics benchmarks, though the methodology behind those results has limits. The article Odyssey-3 is a new generative world model that you can try for free appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Odyssey 正在將其世界模型 Odyssey-3 以公開研究預覽的形式推出。這個擁有 140 億個參數的模型能從文字提示詞即時生成互動式環境，據報導還能控制機器人、無人機，甚至《GTA V》。Odyssey 宣稱其在物理基準測試中獲得最高分，儘管這些結果背後的方法論存在侷限性。這篇「Odyssey-3 是一個你可以免費試用的全新生成式世界模型」文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: "How much beauty have we lost?" Mathematicians react with shock and disgust as OpenAI bulldozes their field
items_ai.summary: OpenAI published more than 700 AI-generated manuscripts claiming solutions to open math problems. A math blog then collected over 100 responses from researchers, ranging from fascination with new ideas to existential fears and grief over a lost way of working. Fields Medalist Hugo Duminil-Copin wrote, "I am paralysed." The article "How much beauty have we lost?" Mathematicians react with shock and disgust as OpenAI bulldozes their field appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: OpenAI 發表了 700 多篇由人工智慧產生的手稿，聲稱能解決開放性數學問題。隨後，一個數學部落格收集了研究人員的 100 多份回應，從對新點子的著迷到對生存的恐懼以及對失去工作方式的哀傷。費爾茲獎得主 Hugo Duminil-Copin 寫道：「我癱瘓了。」文章〈我們失去了多少美？〉數學家們在 OpenAI 席捲他們的領域時感到震驚和厭惡，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Few people pay for AI, but those who do spend big
items_ai.summary: Andreessen Horowitz tracks actual US consumer spending for the first time in its latest Top 100 AI list. Nearly half of US consumers use AI, but only 4.5 percent pay for a subscription. The top one percent of payers spend about $900 a month, mostly on professional tools for development and automation. The article Few people pay for AI, but those who do spend big appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Andreessen Horowitz在其最新的前100大AI清單中首次追蹤了美國消費者的實際支出。近半數的美國消費者使用AI，但只有4.5%的人支付訂閱費用。付費金額最高的前百分之一用戶每個月花費約900美元，主要用於開發和自動化的專業工具。《少數人為AI付費，但付費者出手闊綽》（Few people pay for AI, but those who do spend big）一文最先出現在The Decoder。
